metrics.name: descent_rate_ratio
metrics.notes: Holding chute area, Cd, and altitude constant while doubling mass scales terminal rate by sqrt(2) in this model.

expected.notes: Metamorphic invariant of the browser terminal-descent implementation.

source.derivation: The browser model uses terminal rate proportional to the square root of mass when all other inputs remain constant; doubling mass therefore gives a transformed/base ratio of sqrt(2).
source.notes: This invariant does not establish real-world parachute performance.

comparison.decisionRule: The transformed/base browser output ratio remains sqrt(2) within the stated analytic tolerance; this review case never gates agreement.

notes: Review-only metamorphic coverage; not accepted evidence.
